metadata.description: Agile/Scrum operations plugin for Claude Code, built in the AISW Maestro lecture 'Claude Code로 Agile 프로젝트 운영 스킬 만들고 자동화하기'.

plugins.name: agile-flow
plugins.description: Six skills: five Scrum events (backlog, planning, daily, review, retro) plus a shared jira-connect. Every meeting is logged to agile-logs/ and mirrored to Jira via the Atlassian MCP.
